entries.originalText: Speak Lord, for thy servant heareth.(1) I am Thy servant; O give me understanding that I may know Thy testimonies.
entries.modernizedText: Speak, Lord, for Your servant hears.(1) I am Your servant; O give me understanding that I may know Your testimonies.

entries.originalText: Incline my heart unto the words of Thy mouth.(2) Let thy speech distil as the dew.
entries.modernizedText: Incline my heart to the words of Your mouth.(2) Let Your speech fall like the dew.

entries.originalText: The children of Israel spake in old time to Moses, Speak thou unto us and we will hear, but let not the Lord speak unto us lest we die.(3) Not thus, O Lord, not thus do I pray, but rather with Samuel the prophet, I beseech Thee humbly and earnestly, Speak, Lord, for Thy servant heareth.
entries.modernizedText: The children of Israel spoke in old times to Moses: Speak to us and we will hear, but do not let the Lord speak to us, lest we die.(3) Not thus, O Lord, not thus do I pray, but rather with Samuel the prophet I beseech You humbly and earnestly: Speak, Lord, for Your servant hears.

entries.originalText: Let not Moses speak to me, nor any prophet, but rather speak Thou, O Lord, who didst inspire and illuminate all the prophets; for Thou alone without them canst perfectly fill me with knowledge, whilst they without Thee shall profit nothing.
entries.modernizedText: Let not Moses speak to me, nor any prophet, but rather speak Yourself, O Lord, who inspired and illuminated all the prophets; for You alone can perfectly fill me with knowledge without them, while they can profit nothing without You.

entries.originalText: They can indeed utter words, but they give not the spirit.
entries.modernizedText: They can indeed utter words, but they do not give the spirit.

entries.originalText: They speak with exceeding beauty, but when Thou art silent they kindle not the heart.
entries.modernizedText: They speak with exceeding beauty, but when You are silent they do not kindle the heart.

entries.originalText: They give us scriptures, but Thou makest known the sense thereof.
entries.modernizedText: They give us scriptures, but You make their meaning known.

entries.originalText: They bring us mysteries, but Thou revealest the things which are signified.
entries.modernizedText: They bring us mysteries, but You reveal the things they signify.

entries.originalText: They utter commandments, but Thou helpest to the fulfilling of them.
entries.modernizedText: They utter commandments, but You help us fulfill them.

entries.originalText: They show the way, but Thou givest strength for the journey.
entries.modernizedText: They show the way, but You give strength for the journey.

entries.originalText: They act only outwardly, but Thou dost instruct and enlighten the heart.
entries.modernizedText: They act only outwardly, but You instruct and enlighten the heart.

entries.originalText: They water, but Thou givest the increase.
entries.modernizedText: They water, but You give the increase.

entries.originalText: They cry with words, but Thou givest understanding to the hearer.
entries.modernizedText: They cry out with words, but You give understanding to the hearer.

entries.originalText: Therefore let not Moses speak to me, but Thou, O Lord my God, Eternal Truth; lest I die and bring forth no fruit, being outwardly admonished, but not enkindled within; lest the word heard but not followed, known but not loved, believed but not obeyed, rise up against me in the judgment.
entries.modernizedText: Therefore let not Moses speak to me, but You, O Lord my God, Eternal Truth; lest I die and bear no fruit, being outwardly admonished but not kindled within; lest the word heard but not followed, known but not loved, believed but not obeyed, rise up against me in the judgment.

entries.originalText: Speak, Lord, for Thy servant heareth; Thou hast the words of eternal life.(4) Speak unto me for some consolation unto my soul, for the amendment of my whole life, and for the praise and glory and eternal honour of Thy Name.
entries.modernizedText: Speak, Lord, for Your servant hears; You have the words of eternal life.(4) Speak to me for some consolation to my soul, for the amendment of my whole life, and for the praise and glory and eternal honor of Your Name.
